message.content:
Create the file `app/services/template.server.ts` for QuizSnap.

## Context
This service provides all quiz template definitions and functions to create quizzes from templates. It's used by the quizzes list page (`app.quizzes.tsx`) when a merchant picks a template from the "Create quiz" modal.

## Database Info
The DB is accessed via `import db from "../db.server"` (default export).
Slug generation: `import { generateUniqueSlug } from "../utils/helpers"`.

Prisma models used:
- Quiz: { id, shop, title, description, slug, status, type, settings, styling, completions, startCount, publishedAt, createdAt, updatedAt }
- Question: { id, quizId, type, title, description, imageUrl, required, position, settings (JSON string), logic (JSON string) }
- Answer: { id, questionId, text, imageUrl, position, score, productTags (JSON string), nextQuestionId, metadata (JSON string) }
- ResultPage: { id, quizId, title, description, type, minScore, maxScore, matchTags (JSON string), productLimit, layout, showDiscount, discountType, discountValue, discountCode, ctaText, ctaUrl, styling (JSON string), position }

## What to build

### Exported types:
```typescript
export interface TemplateMeta {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  questionCount: number;
  questionTypes: string;
  badge: "Popular" | "New" | null;
}
```

### Exported functions:
1. `getTemplatesMeta(): TemplateMeta[]` - Returns metadata for the template picker UI
2. `createQuizFromTemplate(shop: string, templateId: string): Promise<string>` - Creates a complete quiz with questions, answers, and result page. Returns quiz ID.
3. `createBlankQuiz(shop: string): Promise<string>` - Creates a quiz with 1 default question ("Your first question" with "Option A" and "Option B" answers) + 1 default result page. Returns quiz ID.

### Template definitions (5 templates):

#### 1. Skincare Finder
- ID: "skincare", Category: "Beauty, Wellness", Badge: "Popular"
- Type: "product-recommendation"
- Description: "Help customers find their perfect skincare routine based on their skin type, concerns, and preferences."
- 5 Questions:
  - Q1 (multiple-choice): "What's your skin type?" - Answers: Oily (tags: oily-skin, mattifying), Dry (tags: dry-skin, hydrating), Combination (tags: combination-skin, balancing), Sensitive (tags: sensitive-skin, gentle), Normal (tags: normal-skin, everyday)
  - Q2 (image-choice): "What's your biggest skin concern?" - Answers: Acne & Breakouts (tags: acne, blemish-control), Wrinkles & Fine Lines (tags: anti-aging, wrinkle-repair), Dark Spots & Uneven Tone (tags: brightening, dark-spots), Redness & Irritation (tags: redness, calming), Dullness & Tired Skin (tags: glow, radiance)
  - Q3 (multiple-choice): "Which ingredients do you prefer?" - description: "Select all that apply" - Answers: Hyaluronic Acid (tags: hyaluronic-acid, hydration), Retinol (tags: retinol, anti-aging), Vitamin C (tags: vitamin-c, brightening), Niacinamide (tags: niacinamide, pore-care), Salicylic Acid (tags: salicylic-acid, acne), Natural & Organic Only (tags: natural, organic). Settings: { allowMultiple: true }
  - Q4 (slider): "How much time do you spend on skincare daily?" - Settings: { min: 1, max: 30, step: 1, unit: "minutes", minLabel: "1 min", maxLabel: "30+ min" } - No answers needed for slider type
  - Q5 (email): "Get your personalized skincare routine" - description: "Enter your email to receive your customized product recommendations and skincare tips." - Settings: { consentText: "I agree to receive skincare tips and product recommendations", skipLinkText: "Skip and see results" }

#### 2. Supplement Advisor
- ID: "supplement", Category: "Health, Fitness", Badge: "New"
- Type: "product-recommendation"  
- Description: "Match customers with the right supplements based on their health goals and dietary needs."
- 4 Questions:
  - Q1 (multiple-choice): "What's your primary health goal?" - Answers: Energy & Focus (tags: energy, focus, mental-clarity), Sleep & Recovery (tags: sleep, recovery, relaxation), Gut Health & Digestion (tags: gut-health, digestive, probiotic), Immune Support (tags: immunity, immune-support, defense), General Wellness (tags: multivitamin, daily-wellness)
  - Q2 (multiple-choice): "Do you follow a plant-based diet?" - 2 answers only (Yes/No style): Yes, I'm plant-based (tags: vegan, plant-based), No, I eat everything (tags: standard-diet)
  - Q3 (multiple-choice): "Any specific concerns? Select all that apply." - Settings: { allowMultiple: true } - Answers: Low energy levels (tags: energy-boost, b-vitamins), Trouble sleeping (tags: sleep-support, melatonin), Joint pain or stiffness (tags: joint-support, collagen), Stress & anxiety (tags: stress-relief, adaptogens), Digestive issues (tags: digestive-support, probiotics), Hair, skin & nail health (tags: beauty-supplement, biotin)
  - Q4 (email): "Get your personalized supplement plan" - description: "We'll email you a tailored supplement recommendation based on your answers." - Settings: { consentText: "Send me my personalized supplement plan and wellness tips", skipLinkText: "Skip and see results" }

#### 3. Style Finder
- ID: "style", Category: "Apparel, Fashion", Badge: null
- Type: "product-recommendation"
- Description: "Help shoppers discover their style profile and find clothes they'll love."
- 4 Questions:
  - Q1 (image-choice): "Which style vibe speaks to you?" - Answers: Minimalist & Clean (tags: minimalist, clean-lines, neutral), Streetwear & Urban (tags: streetwear, urban, bold), Classic & Preppy (tags: classic, preppy, timeless), Bohemian & Relaxed (tags: boho, relaxed, flowing), Edgy & Modern (tags: edgy, modern, statement)
  - Q2 (multiple-choice): "What's your usual go-to outfit?" - Answers: Jeans & a nice top (tags: casual, denim, everyday), A dress or skirt (tags: feminine, dressy, polished), Athleisure all day (tags: athleisure, comfort, sporty), Tailored pieces (tags: tailored, professional, structured)
  - Q3 (dropdown): "What's your preferred colour palette?" - Answers: Neutrals — Black, White, Beige (tags: neutral-palette, monochrome), Warm Tones — Red, Orange, Terracotta (tags: warm-palette, earth-tones), Cool Tones — Blue, Green, Lavender (tags: cool-palette, ocean), Pastels — Soft Pink, Mint, Lilac (tags: pastel-palette, soft), Bold & Bright — Fuchsia, Cobalt, Emerald (tags: bold-palette, vibrant)
  - Q4 (email): "Get your style recommendations" - description: "Enter your email for personalized outfit suggestions curated to your taste." - Settings: { consentText: "Send me style picks and new arrival alerts", skipLinkText: "Skip and see results" }

#### 4. Hair Care Match
- ID: "haircare", Category: "Hair, Beauty", Badge: null
- Type: "product-recommendation"
- Description: "Match customers to the perfect hair care routine based on their hair type and concerns."
- 4 Questions:
  - Q1 (multiple-choice): "What's your hair type?" - Answers: Straight (tags: straight-hair, sleek), Wavy (tags: wavy-hair, texture), Curly (tags: curly-hair, defined-curls), Coily / Textured (tags: coily-hair, textured, protective)
  - Q2 (dropdown): "What's your primary hair concern?" - Answers: Frizz & flyaways (tags: anti-frizz, smoothing), Damage & breakage (tags: repair, damage-control, strengthening), Thinning or lack of volume (tags: volumizing, thickening), Colour-treated maintenance (tags: colour-safe, colour-protection), Dandruff or scalp issues (tags: scalp-care, dandruff, soothing)
  - Q3 (slider): "How often do you wash your hair per week?" - Settings: { min: 1, max: 7, step: 1, unit: "times", minLabel: "1x/week", maxLabel: "Daily" }
  - Q4 (email): "Get your hair care routine" - description: "We'll send your personalized hair care recommendations straight to your inbox." - Settings: { consentText: "Send me hair care tips and product recommendations", skipLinkText: "Skip and see results" }

#### 5. Fitness Advisor
- ID: "fitness", Category: "Sports, Health", Badge: null
- Type: "product-recommendation"
- Description: "Recommend the right fitness gear and supplements based on training level and goals."
- 5 Questions:
  - Q1 (multiple-choice): "What's your current fitness level?" - Answers: Just getting started (tags: beginner, starter, easy), I work out regularly (tags: intermediate, regular, moderate), Athlete / advanced (tags: advanced, athlete, intense)
  - Q2 (multiple-choice): "What are your fitness goals? Select all that apply." - Settings: { allowMultiple: true } - Answers: Build muscle & strength (tags: muscle-building, strength, protein), Lose weight & burn fat (tags: weight-loss, fat-burn, cardio), Improve endurance & stamina (tags: cardio, endurance, running), Increase flexibility (tags: flexibility, yoga, stretching), General health & wellness (tags: general-fitness, wellness, recovery)
  - Q3 (slider): "How many days per week do you train?" - Settings: { min: 0, max: 7, step: 1, unit: "days", minLabel: "Rest day only", maxLabel: "Every day" }
  - Q4 (multiple-choice): "Do you currently use any fitness supplements?" - 2 answers (Yes/No): Yes, I take supplements regularly (tags: supplement-user, experienced), No, I'm new to supplements (tags: supplement-new, first-time)
  - Q5 (email): "Get your personalized fitness plan" - description: "Enter your email for customized workout gear and supplement recommendations." - Settings: { consentText: "Send me fitness tips and product recommendations", skipLinkText: "Skip and see results" }

### Result pages for each template:
Each template gets ONE default result page:
- title: "Your Personalized Recommendations"
- description: "Based on your answers, here are our top picks for you!"
- type: "default"
- productLimit: 4
- layout: "grid"
- position: 0

### Blank quiz defaults:
- title: "My Quiz"
- type: "product-recommendation"
- 1 question: type "multiple-choice", title "Your first question", required true, position 0
  - 2 answers: "Option A" (position 0), "Option B" (position 1)
- 1 result page: title "Your Results", description "Based on your answers, here are our top recommendations for you.", type "default", productLimit 4, layout "grid"

### Important rules:
- All JSON fields (settings, productTags, matchTags, metadata, logic) must be stored as `JSON.stringify(...)` 
- Scores on answers: give each answer a score of (position + 1) * 10 so they have differentiated scores
- Use `generateUniqueSlug(shop, title)` from `../utils/helpers` for slug generation
- Use `db.$transaction()` for creating quiz + questions + answers + result pages atomically
- TypeScript strict mode - no `any` types
- Handle errors with try/catch

Write the COMPLETE file at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/services/template.server.ts`.

Here is a summary of what was built:

---

### What was built

**Exported interface: `TemplateMeta`**
Lightweight shape used by the quiz picker UI — no DB access required when rendering the template gallery.

**`getTemplatesMeta(): TemplateMeta[]`**
Pure in-memory function. Iterates `TEMPLATES`, counts questions, derives a display string of unique question types (e.g. `"Multiple Choice, Image Choice, Slider, Email"`), and returns the badge. Called from the quiz list action or modal loader — zero DB reads.

**`createQuizFromTemplate(shop, templateId): Promise<string>`**
Finds the template by ID, generates a unique slug via `generateUniqueSlug`, then opens a single `db.$transaction`. Inside the transaction: creates the `Quiz` row, then for each `QuestionDefinition` creates the `Question` and its `Answer` rows (score = `(position + 1) * 10`), and finally creates the default `ResultPage`. Returns the new quiz ID. Throws a typed `Error` if the template ID is not recognised.

**`createBlankQuiz(shop): Promise<string>`**
Same transactional pattern. Creates `"My Quiz"` with a single `multiple-choice` question (`"Your first question"`, answers `"Option A"` / `"Option B"`) and a `"Your Results"` result page. Returns the new quiz ID.

**5 template definitions (in-memory only, no `QuizTemplate` table reads)**

| ID | Name | Category | Badge | Questions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `skincare` | Skincare Finder | Beauty, Wellness | Popular | 5 (multiple-choice, image-choice, multiple-choice, slider, email) |
| `supplement` | Supplement Advisor | Health, Fitness | New | 4 (multiple-choice x3, email) |
| `style` | Style Finder | Apparel, Fashion | — | 4 (image-choice, multiple-choice, dropdown, email) |
